oneOf.description: Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP (DASH), an ISO standard for segmented adaptive streaming of speech and audio over HTTP.
HTTP Live Streaming (HLS), Apple's segmented streaming protocol widely used for speech and audio playback across devices.
Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP), a low-latency streaming protocol commonly used for live audio contribution and ingest.
Real-Time Streaming Protocol (RTSP), a control protocol for streaming media that supports interactive playback of audio streams.
Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC), a peer-to-peer, ultra-low-latency streaming framework for live speech and audio communication.
Icecast streaming, an HTTP-based protocol used for continuous live audio streams, including radio and speech channels.
